showcase.user_prompt: Start my local free-model server and add its models to the model list.
showcase.assistant_reply: Server running, health check passed. Free models are synced into your model list — pick one and start chatting.

items.title: Runtime ships with the plugin
items.description: The whole upstream standalone server tree is bundled; the host starts it with its managed Node and injects the port and data directory. No repo clone, no path setup.

items.title: One-click lifecycle
items.description: Installs and starts on activation, cleaned up automatically on plugin disable and app quit; manual start/stop, restart and logs included.

items.title: Models auto-listed
items.description: Once ready it reads the server-generated key, fetches /v1/models and writes them into the host model registry as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

items.title: Informed risk
items.description: A built-in disclaimer: the upstream reuses vendor free channels and may violate their terms; the user accepts all consequences.
